categories.title: Getting started
categories.summary: The E1 window: menus, the left rail, the explorer, tabs, the side panel, the status bar, keyboard shortcuts, your settings and Help.

categories.title: Installation and sign-in
categories.summary: Open E1 in the browser or the desktop app, sign in with your company account or Microsoft, passkeys, sessions and the store E1 runs on.

categories.title: Projects and the explorer
categories.summary: Create, rename, arrange and delete projects and folders, the sections of a project, the Bin, searching and dragging in the explorer.

categories.title: Drawing P&IDs

categories.title: Lists and queries

categories.title: Documents, revisions and datasheets

categories.title: Working together
categories.summary: History and undo, comments and mentions, tasks and the Inbox, comments pinned on drawings, attachments and live updates between people.

categories.title: Organization, members and access
categories.summary: Your organization, invitations, licenses and seats, project members and roles, exporting the organization, and the access control being built.

categories.title: Configuration, library and catalogs
categories.summary: The Configuration place: classes, attributes, shapes, the company library with drafts, publishing and upgrades, catalogs, content packages and project settings.

categories.title: AI: Alex
categories.summary: Alex, the built-in engineering co-worker that reviews your drawing and, with help from a language model when you tick it, answers in your own words and changes the project with review and undo.

categories.title: Your account, Academy and website
categories.summary: The account page on lanxtor.com: licenses, usage, organizations, projects, billing, downloads, the Academy with courses and certificates, Shape E1 and Alex on the website.

categories.title: E1 Reviewer for iPad
categories.summary: Review E1 projects on the iPad: dashboards, projects, sheets, objects, photos and voice notes, redlining, your tasks and checklists, search and Alex.

features.title: The E1 window

features.title: The File menu

features.title: The Edit menu

features.roles: Anyone who may edit the project

features.title: The View menu (removed)
features.summary: No View menu any more: the appearance, zoom, panels and drawing aids are on the status bar, the drawing toolbar and the rail.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: The Insert menu (removed)
features.summary: No Insert menu any more: the drawing toolbar has every tool it started.
features.roles: Anyone who may edit the drawing

features.title: The Data menu (removed)
features.summary: No Data menu any more: datasheets, revisions and the import open where the object, project or section is.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: The Help menu and About E1
features.summary: Keyboard shortcuts, Under construction and the version of E1.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: The left rail
features.summary: The icons that open the Inbox, Configuration, Settings and Account and show or hide the panels.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: The places: Inbox, Configuration, Settings and Account
features.summary: Pages that are not part of one project, each opened as a tab from the left rail.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Tabs and the path bar
features.summary: Work with several open items in tabs, find any tab, and see where the open item lives.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Floating windows
features.summary: Take a tab out into its own window to work side by side or on a second screen.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Hide and show the explorer and the side panel
features.summary: Give the drawing more room and bring the panels back from the left rail.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: The status bar
features.summary: See whether your changes are saved, what is selected, what an edit touched and which store E1 runs on.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Light and dark appearance
features.summary: Switch E1 between dark and light; the choice is kept in this browser.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Keyboard shortcuts
features.summary: Every key and mouse move of E1, as listed in Help and a few more.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Your settings
features.summary: Your own preferences: appearance, how Alex changes drawings with its AI help, email notifications, and whether you share usage statistics.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Usage statistics: your choice
features.summary: Whether E1 may share with LANXTOR how you use it: active time, clicks and the functions you use, never your content. Off unless you agree.
features.roles: Everyone, for themselves

features.title: What E1 remembers
features.summary: Your changes are saved as you make them and your tabs, selection and open rows come back after a reload.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Under construction and the roadmap
features.summary: See every milestone, how far it is, what to try, and the controls that do not work yet.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Units of measurement
features.summary: The status bar shows the project's unit system and opens Project settings, where it is chosen.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Messages
features.summary: Direct messages between people; not connected yet and no button on the screen.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: Open E1 in the browser
features.summary: Use E1 in the browser with nothing to install, on any computer or tablet.
features.roles: Anyone with an E1 account

features.title: The desktop app for Windows and macOS
features.summary: The desktop app for Windows and Macs with Apple silicon, signed, that connects to E1 Cloud or your organization's server and keeps itself up to date.
features.roles: Anyone with an E1 account

features.title: Keep the desktop app up to date
features.summary: The desktop app finds a new version by itself, downloads it in the background and asks you to restart; Check for Updates… looks at once.
features.roles: Anyone using the desktop app

features.title: Sign in to E1
features.summary: Sign in with your organization's account; the first sign-in creates your account and a personal workspace.
features.roles: Anyone with an account at the installation's sign-in provider

features.title: Sign in with your company's Microsoft account
features.summary: Sign in with your work Microsoft account where your company has connected it to E1.
features.roles: People whose email domain is one of the company's domains in E1

features.title: Claim a new installation
features.summary: The first installation operator who signs in on a new installation becomes its owner.
features.roles: An installation operator (an email in E1_OPERATORS)

features.title: When sign-in is refused
features.summary: The messages E1 shows when it cannot let you in, and what to do.
features.roles: Everyone signing in

features.title: Passkeys
features.summary: Sign in with your screen lock or a security key, confirm important actions, and make administrator roles take effect.
features.roles: Everyone signed in on a server with sign-in

features.title: Confirm it is you
features.summary: Important actions need a sign-in younger than 15 minutes, or a passkey confirmation.
features.roles: Whoever starts an important action

features.title: Session length, sign out and switching organization
features.summary: A sign-in lasts 12 hours; sign out, and switch between your organizations.
features.roles: Everyone signed in

features.title: The 30-day trial
features.summary: An organization of your own for 30 days; afterwards it is read-only and can still be viewed and exported.
features.roles: Anyone LANXTOR invites to a trial

features.title: Which store and cloud E1 runs on
features.summary: The status bar names where your projects are kept: Microsoft Azure, PostgreSQL or a local file.
features.roles: Everyone who can open E1

features.title: E1's reference cloud
features.summary: E1's own cloud on Microsoft Azure (app.lanxtor.com) is the reference installation that customers and reviewers use.
features.roles: Everyone with an E1 cloud account

features.title: Company single sign-on and directory sync
features.summary: SAML sign-in and directory sync for companies, beyond Sign in with Microsoft.
features.roles: Companies with their own sign-in system

features.title: Create a project
features.summary: Make a new project with its nine sections from the explorer header, the File menu or the organization menu.
features.roles: A license (without one you can only view)

features.title: Rename a project
features.summary: Rename a project in the tree with F2 or on its data sheet; the name is kept after a reload.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit the project

features.title: The sections of a project
features.summary: The nine fixed sections of every project, what each holds and what can be made in it.
features.roles: Anyone who can open the project

training.topic: The nine sections of a project

features.title: Rows, clicks and marks in the explorer
features.summary: What a click, a double-click and the arrow do on each kind of row, and what the marks at the end of a row mean.
features.roles: Anyone who can open the project

features.title: Folders and 2D spaces inside a project
features.summary: Make, nest, rename, void and delete folders in any section and 2D spaces in Model Space.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit the project

features.title: Move rows by drag and drop
features.summary: Drag 2D spaces, folders, objects and projects in the explorer; drops that do not fit are refused.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit the project

training.topic: Drag and drop in the explorer

features.title: Search the explorer
features.summary: Filter the tree as you type and find objects by tag, name, line number or any value (also as a quantity: 24 volt) in all your projects.
features.roles: Anyone who can open the project

features.title: The explorer header: expand, collapse and more
features.summary: The buttons at the top of the explorer: new project, delete, search, Expand all, Collapse all, Retag… and hide.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Arrange projects in folders, Move up and Move down
features.summary: Put your projects in personal folders and in your own order; it changes nothing for anyone else.
features.roles: Everyone (the arrangement is personal)

features.title: The organization menu and switching organization
features.summary: The menu on the organization's name: new project, new folder, a query over all projects, and Switch organization.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Delete a project and restore it from the Bin
features.summary: A deleted project goes to the Bin, from where it is restored or deleted permanently.
features.roles: A project role that may delete the project

features.title: The project Bin: Deleted bin and Voided bin
features.summary: Restore, delete permanently or empty what was deleted in a project, and unvoid what was voided.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit the project

features.title: Branches
features.summary: The Branches section takes folders today; branches of the plant model are planned for milestone M8.
features.roles: Everyone can see the section

features.title: The sample project: Demo Plant
features.summary: Every new organization and every new desktop install starts with Demo Plant (sample), the DEXPI reference P&ID imported by E1, to learn and try E1 on; delete it when you no longer need it and add a fresh copy at any time.
features.roles: Everyone in a new organization sees it as its owner made it; adding a copy needs the permissions to create a project and to import data

training.topic: Getting started on the sample project

features.title: Import a DEXPI P&ID
features.summary: Bring a P&ID from another tool into a project as objects, values and a drawing, and import it again later to update what is there, deciding every difference yourself.
features.roles: The Import data permission in the project (Project administrator and Lead engineer have it) and the permissions of the changes the import makes

training.topic: Importing a P&ID from another tool

features.title: Import Excel workbooks
features.summary: Bring tag lists and data sheets from Excel into a project: each sheet becomes a kind of object and each column an attribute; import again later to update what is there, deciding every value E1 already holds yourself.
features.roles: The Import data permission in the project (Project administrator and Lead engineer have it) and the permissions of the changes the import makes

training.topic: Importing tag lists and data sheets from Excel

features.title: Import a P&ID from CAD (DXF)
features.summary: Bring a P&ID drawn in CAD into a project as objects on a 2D space: blocks become objects of the class they are named for or look like, lines become connected pipes and signals; import again to update.
features.roles: The Import data permission in the project (Project administrator and Lead engineer have it) and the permissions of the changes the import makes

features.title: Import a P&ID from a PDF
features.summary: Bring a P&ID exported from CAD as a PDF into a project: E1 finds its symbols, recognizes them by their look, takes the texts beside them as tags, and draws them connected on a 2D space.
features.roles: The Import data permission in the project (Project administrator and Lead engineer have it) and the permissions of the changes the import makes

training.topic: Importing a P&ID from a PDF

features.title: Create an object
features.summary: Make an equipment item, function, area or other object from a library class allowed in the section.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Make several objects at once
features.summary: Create up to 100 objects of one class in one go, numbered after the tag or name you type.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: The object window and its tabs
features.summary: Each object's own tab: header with class, tag and name, and the tabs Attributes, Relationships, Deep view, Data sheet, Chat, History and Attachments.
features.roles: Anyone who can open the project; editing needs a role that may edit objects

features.title: Fill in attributes: values, units, pick lists and required values
features.summary: Enter values with units, choose from pick lists, filter the attributes and see which required values are missing.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Sub-attributes
features.summary: Read and fill indented sub-attributes such as Design pressure / In, and add your own to one object.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Add an attribute to one object
features.summary: Add a library attribute or a free text attribute to a single object.
features.roles: The permission to add attributes to objects

training.topic: Adding an attribute to one object

features.title: Automatic tags and reference designations
features.summary: New objects are tagged from the project's rules (P-001, P-002) with their designation, and a tag whose input changed is marked out of date.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Set a manual tag with Tag…
features.summary: See where a tag comes from and set a manual tag, or go back to the rule's tag.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Retag… with preview
features.summary: Give objects the tags their rules give now, after a preview of every old and new tag.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Set up tag rules for a project
features.summary: Build a project's tag rules from segments, lookup tables and options, see a sample, test against the project and save.
features.roles: A project role that may change the project's settings

features.title: Relate objects
features.summary: Connect objects, for example a function that is implemented by a pump: pick the other object in a tree of what fits, or drag one onto the other in the explorer with the right mouse button; see it from both sides and remove it.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Hookups: how instruments are fixed and connected
features.summary: Turn hookups on for a project, make them in Assets ▸ Hookups with their type, mounting, drawing and bill of material, choose on every instrument which hookup it uses, and see on every hookup the instruments that use it.
features.roles: A project role that may configure the project (to turn hookups on); a license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Rename an object
features.summary: Change an object's name in the explorer or in its window.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Cases of an object
features.summary: Make variants of an object that inherit its values until you type their own.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Move an object
features.summary: Drag an object to a folder or section where its class may live.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Void an object
features.summary: Take an object out of use without deleting it; unvoid it from the Voided bin.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may edit objects

features.title: Delete an object, restore it, or delete it permanently
features.summary: Delete moves an object to the Deleted bin; Restore brings it back, and Delete permanently… previews what goes with it.
features.roles: A license and a project role that may delete objects

features.title: Deep view
features.summary: A graphical view of an object; today the tab and menu item show a placeholder.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Units of measurement
features.summary: Type the number and choose the unit beside it; changing the unit of a value asks Convert or Change unit only.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Calculations and copy rules on attributes
features.summary: Attribute values computed from other attributes or related objects, check rules and copy rules are planned in M6 Rules.

features.title: Open a 2D space, zoom and pan
features.summary: Open a 2D space as a drawing and move around it with the wheel, the zoom controls, Fit drawing, the Pan tool and Space.
features.roles: Anyone who can open the project

training.topic: Finding your way around a 2D space

features.title: The drawing toolbar and the formatting bar
features.summary: The three rows above the 2D space: what to add, the editing tools, and text and line formatting.
features.roles: Everyone sees it; editing needs edit rights on the drawing

training.topic: A tour of the drawing toolbar

features.title: Snap, Grid and Ortho
features.summary: Turn the grid, snapping onto nozzles and horizontal-or-vertical lines on and off, kept per person.
features.roles: Everyone; the setting is per person

features.title: Place a symbol
features.summary: Place equipment, valves and instruments from the Add asset window; each symbol becomes a new object with its next free name or tag.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Add other objects with the Object button
features.summary: Make unit operations, systems, processes and areas from the drawing toolbar's Object type menu.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

training.topic: The Object button and its types

features.title: Draw pipes, signals and cables with Connector
features.summary: Draw flow lines, cables, wires and logic signals point by point; every line is an object that connects what it touches.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Connection rules: one pipe per nozzle, lines that follow and heal
features.summary: A nozzle takes one pipe end, lines follow moved symbols, and deleting an inline symbol joins the line again.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Select symbols, lines and notes
features.summary: Select with a click, Shift-click or Ctrl-click, a frame, a double-click on a run, or Select all.
features.roles: Anyone who can open the project

features.title: Move, flip, resize and align
features.summary: Move symbols with their lines, flip them, resize them with grips and align, distribute or match their size.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Undo, redo, copy, paste and duplicate
features.summary: Copy, paste and duplicate make new objects with new tags; undo and redo work step by step across the project.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

training.topic: Copy, paste and undo on the drawing

features.title: Delete on the drawing: the placement or the object
features.summary: Remove a symbol from this drawing only, or delete its object to the Deleted bin.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Tags, names and line numbers on the 2D space
features.summary: Symbols show their tags, pipe runs their line numbers; drag and rotate the labels and tag a symbol with the Tag tool.
features.roles: Everyone sees labels; moving them and tagging need edit rights

training.topic: Tags and line numbers on the 2D space

features.title: Text notes and text formatting
features.summary: Place text notes and format notes and symbol names: font, colour, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, size and rotation.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Line style, thickness and colour
features.summary: Set a selected line's thickness, colour and solid or dashed pattern.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Flow arrows, flow direction and line crossings
features.summary: Flow arrows show the direction of flow lines; flip a line's direction, and choose gaps or line jumps at crossings.
features.roles: Editor license; the crossing style needs a role that may change project settings

features.title: Highlight flow
features.summary: Trace where a line's or a symbol's flow goes, optionally through pumps and compressors and across 2D spaces.
features.roles: Anyone who can open the project

features.title: Layers
features.summary: Hide process, instrumentation, electrical or annotation content of a 2D space for yourself.
features.roles: Everyone; the setting is per person and per 2D space

features.title: System and area frames
features.summary: Draw a rectangle, circle or freehand frame so the symbols inside belong to a system or area.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Off-page connectors and Continue on 2D space
features.summary: Carry a line to other 2D spaces with off-page connectors: link them end to end or let one continue on several, jump between them, and disconnect; Highlight flow and Alex follow the links.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

training.topic: Off-page connectors: linking and continuing on other 2D spaces

features.title: The right-click menus on the 2D space, and Replace
features.summary: The grouped right-click menus of symbols, lines and empty spots, and Replace, which swaps a symbol and keeps the object.
features.roles: Everyone; editing items need edit rights

features.title: Chat here: pin a message on the drawing
features.summary: Pin a chat message on a symbol; the object needs review until the message is resolved.
features.roles: Anyone who may write in the chat in the project

training.topic: Chat messages pinned on the drawing

features.title: ISA 5.1 and ISO 10628 symbols
features.summary: Browse the shapes by standard in Configuration → Shapes and filter the Add asset window by standard.
features.roles: Everyone can browse

features.title: Drop an object from the explorer onto the 2D space or a line
features.summary: Drag an existing object from the explorer onto a 2D space; dropped on a pipe, it goes into the line.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Predictive mode: Let Alex help
features.summary: Alex reviews the drawing as you work and offers the next symbols as ghosts, with an After your change card in Alex (Co-engineer) to apply or reject, locally without the cloud.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Engineering patterns
features.summary: Draw a redundant pump train, an instrument tap or a motor feeder at once, placed, routed and checked.
features.roles: Editor license; an AI model set up (Alex's Agent tab)

features.title: Generated loop diagrams
features.summary: Generate a control function's loop diagram from the model, move symbols by hand, and regenerate while keeping your moves.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit the project

features.title: Symbol designer and Modify shape…
features.summary: Draw your own symbols with their connection points and publish them, or adapt a placed symbol for one project with Modify shape….
features.roles: Project administrator (Modify shape…); Library administrator (company shapes)

features.title: Attribute labels on symbols
features.summary: Labels on a symbol that show an attribute value with its unit, always current, on the 2D space and in the PDF.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: SVG import into the symbol designer
features.summary: Import an SVG drawing as a shape draft: read safely, fitted into the shape, connection points suggested.
features.roles: Library administrator

features.title: Symbol versions on placements
features.summary: Placements keep the shape version they were placed with; Updates available lists them and upgrades them with a preview.
features.roles: Library administrator (publishes the new version); anyone who may edit drawings (upgrades placements)

features.title: Pipelines and completeness checks
features.summary: Define a pipeline from one equipment nozzle to another, or create one from a selected pipe: it holds the pipe runs, valves and fittings between them in piping segments, goes on across off-page connectors, takes the line number, names From and To, and a double-click selects it whole.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Check piping and flow direction
features.summary: Check every pipe on a 2D space: flow that leaves an inlet or enters an outlet, pipe that meets head-on, a pump turned the wrong way, incomplete pipelines, and pipe in no pipeline; fix with Flip the flow of the chain or Turn around, and make the proposed pipelines with Detect pipelines.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings (Check piping: any role that can view the project)

training.topic: Flow direction and the piping check

features.title: Pipe classes
features.summary: Keep your piping specifications as pipe classes in the company or project library, import them from a spreadsheet, and name one on a pipeline: its segments get schedule, material and rating, and the piping check holds them to the class's envelope, sizes and components.
features.roles: Company library: a role with library.edit:pipe-class (or library.edit) to save drafts and library.publish to publish; a project's own classes: Project administrator

features.title: Pipe schedule (line list)
features.summary: Build the pipe schedule as a query on the project's pipelines: line number, From and To, size, pipe class, design conditions and the P&IDs each is drawn on, with its segments' schedule, material and rating; save it for the project and issue it as a list document in Excel and PDF.
features.roles: Anyone who can view the project builds and exports it; saving it for the project needs project.configure

features.title: DEXPI exchange and handover
features.summary: Hand P&IDs and their pipelines over to 3D design tools and the owner in the DEXPI format (after the MVP; importing DEXPI is available).
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: CAD import (DXF, later DWG)
features.summary: Import CAD drawings as a dimmed background layer to trace over.
features.roles: Editor license; a project role that may edit drawings

features.title: Redlining
features.summary: Mark up 2D spaces in review rounds on a separate Markups layer that never changes the drawing.
features.roles: Reviewers and editors

features.title: Open a query with New query…
features.summary: Opens a live table of every object below a project, section, folder, 2D space or object.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Sort by a column
features.summary: Click a column header to sort the rows ascending or descending.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Choose the columns
features.summary: Add properties, attributes and related objects as columns with the Columns picker.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Engineering columns: Designation, Owner path and related objects
features.summary: Show an object's designation, its owner path, and what it connects to, by name or as a count.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Engineering columns for an equipment list

features.title: Catalog columns
features.summary: Show which catalog item an object was made from, its version and whether an update is available.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Filter rows with AND, OR and NOT
features.summary: Build a filter from conditions joined by AND or OR, each one optionally negated with NOT.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Filtering with AND, OR and NOT

features.title: Read the filter in words and clear it
features.summary: The active filter is shown above the table in plain language; Clear filter removes it.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Ask when opened: one query for many values
features.summary: Leave a filter value out so whoever opens the query types it in each time.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

training.topic: Queries that ask for a value

features.title: Group & totals
features.summary: Group the rows by a column and add a sum, minimum, maximum, average or count per attribute.
features.roles: Any project role that may view the project

features.title: Save a query as a template and reopen it under Query ▸
features.summary: Save the columns, filter, sort and grouping as a named template for yourself, the project or the organization.
features.roles: For me: may view the project. For this project: may configure the project. For the organization: may publish to the company library

training.topic: Saving a list as a template

features.title: Edit a cell like in Excel
features.summary: Double-click or press F2 on a cell to change a name or an attribute value; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

features.title: Paste a block from Excel
features.summary: Paste cells copied from Excel into the table; a preview shows every change or problem first.
features.roles: A project role that may edit objects

features.title: Select many cells and Set value…
features.summary: Select a block of cells and give them all one value in one undoable step.

features.summary: The organization's projects you can open, with your role and when you last opened them.
features.roles: Anyone signed in

features.title: Permissions: what you may do
features.summary: Your organization roles, groups, permissions and content packages.
features.roles: Anyone signed in

features.title: Billing: plan, payment and invoices
features.summary: Your organization's plan, payment and invoices: invoices come by email, payable by bank transfer or card; the online billing portal is not connected yet.
features.roles: Owners and billing administrators

features.title: Get E1: browser and desktop
features.summary: Download E1 for Mac or Windows, or find E1 Reviewer for iPad, with the three buttons at the top of Get E1; or use E1 in the browser with nothing to install.
features.roles: Anyone

features.title: E1 Cloud specifications
features.summary: What is behind the E1 Cloud on one page: where your data is kept, measured performance, security, who can see what, backups and restores, standards, apps and limits.
features.roles: Anyone

features.title: Desktop installers for Windows and macOS
features.summary: Signed installers for the E1 desktop app.
features.roles: Anyone

features.title: Licenses, prices, currencies and the trial
features.summary: Compare the licenses and prices in four currencies, and request a 30-day trial.
features.roles: Anyone

features.title: Academy: your courses
features.summary: Your video courses with progress, continue where you left off, and your certificates.
features.roles: Anyone signed in; full Academy with an annual Editor subscription or bought separately

features.title: Take a course in the course player
features.summary: Watch lessons, mark them done, and pass the final assessment for a certificate.
features.roles: Anyone signed in with the course in their plan

features.title: Your certificates
features.summary: Every certificate you earned, with links to view, share and add to LinkedIn.
features.roles: Anyone signed in

features.title: The public certificate page
features.summary: A public page per certificate to verify, share, download or print it.
features.roles: Anyone with the link

features.title: User guides
features.summary: Every feature of E1, step by step, with its status and the date it last changed.
features.roles: Anyone

features.title: The Academy page
features.summary: The public page with the courses on offer and what the Academy costs.
features.roles: Anyone

features.title: Alex on the website: ask and follow the suggestions
features.summary: Ask the website assistant about E1 by typing or clicking its suggested questions.
features.roles: Anyone

features.title: The Shape E1 board: requests and votes
features.summary: Search, vote for, comment on and post feature requests for E1.
features.roles: Reading: anyone; posting, voting and commenting: signed in

features.title: Languages
features.summary: The website in English, German, French, Spanish and Norwegian.
features.roles: Anyone

features.title: Open E1 Reviewer on the iPad and sign in
features.summary: Open your E1's /reviewer/ address in Safari on the iPad, sign in with your company account, and add it to the Home Screen; the E1 Reviewer app, once released, signs in the same way.
features.roles: Everyone with an E1 account

features.title: Your profile and organization
features.summary: The avatar in the top bar shows who is signed in, the organizations you belong to, and Sign out; tap another organization to work in it.
features.roles: Everyone

training.topic: Profile and organizations on the iPad

features.title: The dashboard
features.summary: Home and each project's Overview show a dashboard of cards; in a project, every 2D space (with pins), the documents, pinned 2D spaces, redlines and recent changes.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Customize a dashboard for you, the project or the organization
features.summary: Customize adds, removes, orders and sizes the cards and saves the dashboard for you, for everyone in the project, or for everyone in the organization.
features.roles: Everyone for Just me; a project administrator for Everyone in the project; an organization administrator for Everyone in the organization

features.title: Projects as tiles you arrange
features.summary: Home shows your projects as tiles; touch and hold a tile, or tap Arrange, and drag the tiles into the order you want. The order is kept for you.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: A project's 2D spaces
features.summary: A project lists its 2D spaces on the left, and the list can be hidden; the 2D space shows as E1 draws it. One finger moves it, two fingers zoom; pin the 2D spaces you use most.
features.roles: Everyone with a role in the project

features.title: An object or a connection: properties, attributes, history and chat
features.summary: Tap a symbol, a pipe, a signal or a cable on a 2D space to see its object: properties, every attribute, its history and its chat.
features.roles: Everyone with a role in the project; writing in the chat needs a role that may comment

features.title: Photos and voice notes
features.summary: Take a photo with the iPad's camera or record a voice note and add it to an object, a comment or a task; they are kept with the object's files in E1.
features.roles: Everyone with a role in the project that may edit the object (adding files)

features.title: Redline a 2D space
features.summary: Redline draws on a 2D space with a pen, a cloud, an arrow or text in four colors; each mark says what it means and carries a note, and its status can be set.
features.roles: Everyone with a role in the project that may comment; setting another person's status needs a role that may resolve comments

features.title: For me: your tasks and checklists
features.summary: For me lists the tasks and checklists assigned to you in every project; tick the items, add items, comment with photos and voice notes, and mark a task done.
features.roles: Everyone; ticking needs the task to be yours or a role that may edit it

training.topic: Tasks and checklists on the iPad

features.title: Search
features.summary: The search field finds projects, 2D spaces, objects and connections by tag or name, and tasks; an object opens as its own page, with its 2D spaces one tap away.
features.roles: Everyone

features.title: Alex on the iPad
features.summary: Alex on the iPad is Ask: questions typed or spoken with the microphone, answered without changing anything.
features.roles: Everyone with a role in the project
